facts.business: Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems Limited manufactures electrical control panels, switchgear, and related components for industrial applications.

capacity_or_capex.item: Property, plant and equipment (Net of Advances)

key_risks: Concentration risk: One customer contributed 10% or more of total revenue (Rs 16,436.58 Lakhs in FY2026)
Contingent liabilities related to tax disputes (Central Excise/Service Tax, GST, Income Tax) and bank guarantees
Dependence on related party LMW Limited for material transactions up to Rs 450 Crores annually
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions with LMW Limited (formerly Lakshmi Machine Works Limited) for an amount not exceeding Rs 450 Crores for the period from the conclusion of the 45th AGM till the conclusion of the next AGM.
